```rust title="Rust"

class"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"diagnostics":true,"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let _ = process(source, &config);
```
